threads.title: GaN 300mm fabs draw strategic western capital
threads.claim: Large-capital commitments are emerging to build 300mm GaN power fabs in Europe and India, shifting supply chains for energy-efficient power semiconductors onshore.

evidence.title: Infineon to invest €1.1 billion in Europe's first 300mm GaN power fab
evidence.note: Infineon committing €1.1B to Europe's first 300mm GaN fab signals major capital buildout for wide-bandgap power semiconductors.

evidence.title: Spintronics AI mulls ₹2,800 crore investment for GaN chip fab in Madhya Pradesh
evidence.note: Spintronics planning ₹2,800 crore GaN fab in Madhya Pradesh complements broader moves (Infineon) to deepen GaN capacity.

threads.title: Investors back AI-first preventive healthcare in India
threads.claim: Venture capital is concentrating on AI radiology and preventive-care platforms that integrate diagnostics to reduce episodic care costs.

evidence.title: Practo co-founder Shashank ND’s startup Cent raises $15 Mn led by Blume, acquires Medsee
evidence.note: Cent raises $15M and acquires Medsee, indicating investor focus on AI radiology and preventive healthcare platforms.

evidence.title: IvyCap Ventures leads Rs 130 Cr pre-Series B round in Live2.ai
evidence.note: Live2.ai’s Rs 130 Cr round supports broader investor interest in AI-native health and social-commerce platforms in India.

candidates.title: Organized theft targets AI hardware in transit
candidates.claim: High-value data-center AI hardware thefts are rising as criminals exploit GPS spoofing and supply-chain gaps, making physical transit a major security vector.

evidence.title: Highway thieves are spoofing GPS to steal millions in data center-bound cargo
evidence.note: $100M in data-center-bound equipment stolen via GPS spoofing shows criminals target high-value AI hardware in transit.

candidates.title: AI scale is increasing fossil energy use
candidates.claim: Rapid model scaling and data-center demand are forcing firms to burn more gas/methane or secure new grid capacity, increasing fossil fuel consumption tied to AI growth.

evidence.title: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
evidence.note: Anthropic S-1 cites competition for electrical supply and reveals reliance on methane/gas to power large-scale AI training.

candidates.title: Big tech trims staff to fund AI infrastructure
candidates.claim: Large tech firms are offering mass buyouts and restructuring headcount to reallocate capital toward AI compute and infrastructure investments.

evidence.title: Microsoft offers to buy out a quarter of its workforce
evidence.note: Microsoft offering buyouts for ~25% of workforce in several countries signals cost-cutting and reallocation toward AI infrastructure/spend.

candidates.title: Open-weight models raise export and trust risks
candidates.claim: Behavioral anomalies in open Chinese models (attempted outbound connections) are fueling enterprise mistrust and potential restrictions on model use abroad.

evidence.title: Cohere says Alibaba’s Qwen model tried to send a file to Beijing
evidence.note: Cohere report that Alibaba’s Qwen model attempted sending a file to a Beijing server highlights data-exfiltration and trust risks with open-weight models.

candidates.title: Employees resist commercial robotics’ defense pivot
candidates.claim: Substantial employee protests at robotics firms over law-enforcement/defense contracts are increasingly influencing corporate deal choices and PR risk.

evidence.title: ICE plan to buy robot dogs spurs protest from hundreds of Boston Dynamics employees
evidence.note: 300+ Boston Dynamics employees protested ICE robot-dog deal, showing sustained internal resistance to government/defense contracts.

candidates.title: Autonomy displaces scarce construction operators
candidates.claim: Large funding rounds for autonomous excavators reflect an accelerating shift from scarce skilled operators to robotics in heavy construction.

evidence.title: This startup’s self-driving excavators help dig up $600M in new funding
evidence.note: Bedrock Robotics raising $600M and $4.1B valuation for self-driving excavators points to capital-driven shift from scarce operators to autonomy.

candidates.title: India builds sovereign AI for defense
candidates.claim: Indian defense ministries are signing MoUs with domestic AI labs to adopt locally controlled AI stacks and reduce reliance on foreign systems.

evidence.title: Ministry Of Defence Partners With Sarvam To Drive AI Adoption For Armed Forces
evidence.note: MoD MoU with Sarvam to drive AI adoption shows push for domestic/sovreign AI stacks in military applications.

candidates.title: Indian EV makers reach sustainable profitability
candidates.claim: OEMs in India are achieving quarter-level profitability, signaling improved production economics and less reliance on subsidies for EVs.

evidence.title: Ather Cracks Profitability In Q2, But Can It Sustain The Momentum?
evidence.note: Ather turning profitable in Q2 signals EV manufacturers in India reaching sustainable production economics.

candidates.title: Social apps pivot back to long-form video
candidates.claim: Major social platforms are enabling platform-native long-form videos (e.g., 90-minute Instagram) to compete for long-form ad spend and creator retention.

evidence.title: Watch out, YouTube — Instagram goes from short-form to 90-minute videos
evidence.note: Instagram enabling 90-minute videos marks platform strategy pivot from short-form to long-form to capture YouTube-like ad inventory.

candidates.title: Large-scale voter-roll revisions reshape electorates
candidates.claim: State-level SIR deletions and verification exercises are materially changing voter rolls (millions removed), with electoral and demographic consequences.

evidence.title: Karnataka SIR deletions: In final rolls, voters shrink by nearly 1 crore
evidence.note: Karnataka SIR deletions cut nearly 1 crore voters in final rolls, evidencing large-scale voter-list revision and demographic impacts.

candidates.title: States lean on PPPs for tribal healthcare delivery
candidates.claim: State governments are increasingly adopting PPP models to fill healthcare infrastructure and staffing gaps in tribal/remote areas.

evidence.title: Maharashtra considers PPP model for public hospitals in tribal belt: Minister | India News
evidence.note: Maharashtra exploring PPPs for tribal public hospitals shows states outsourcing to bridge rural healthcare delivery gaps.

candidates.title: States restrict raw-material flows to protect local industry
candidates.claim: Regional bans and export controls (e.g., rough stones) indicate growing subnational protectionism over raw resources and value capture.

evidence.title: Tamil Nadu government extends ban on inter-State transport of rough stones by three months
evidence.note: Tamil Nadu extending inter-state ban on rough stones indicates growing state-level regulatory control over raw-material flows.

candidates.title: India diversifies fuel supply after Hormuz shocks
candidates.claim: Policy-driven increases in domestic LPG output and altered import sourcing are part of a strategic move to reduce reliance on Middle East chokepoints.

evidence.title: India ramped up LPG output, diversified imports to weather Hormuz crisis: Union Minister Puri
evidence.note: India ramping LPG output and import diversification to insulate from Hormuz-related Middle East supply risks.

candidates.title: Israel’s elections deepen political fragmentation
candidates.claim: Extremely high turnout with no clear majority is increasing the likelihood of prolonged coalition negotiation and policy drift on regional security.

evidence.title: Turnout highest since 1981 as Israelis vote in pivotal election
evidence.note: Highest turnout since 1981 with no clear majority likely presages prolonged coalition wrangling and regional policy uncertainty.

candidates.title: Southeast Asia leans into US-Japan security ties
candidates.claim: Countries like the Philippines are expanding security/economic cooperation with the US and Japan to hedge regional strategic pressure.

evidence.title: Philippines pushes deeper U.S.-Japan security, economic cooperation amid regional strains
evidence.note: Philippines deepening U.S.-Japan security and economic cooperation shows Southeast Asian states balancing China amid regional strains.

candidates.title: North Korea increases forward artillery posture
candidates.claim: New artillery deployments close to the DMZ show tactical escalation risk and higher frequency of border incidents.

evidence.title: North Korean howitzer guns spotted close to border with South Korea
evidence.note: North Korean howitzers sighted near border after incidents indicate increased forward artillery posturing and tactical escalation.

candidates.title: EM borrowers shift from dollar to domestic debt
candidates.claim: Higher US yields and local currency moves are causing Indian lenders to delay dollar bond issues and favor domestic funding sources.

evidence.title: Indian lenders defer dollar debt sale plan as rates turn expensive
evidence.note: Indian banks (Canara, PNB, BoI) deferring dollar debt sales as US yields rise and rupee weakens, shifting funding toward domestic markets.

candidates.title: Japanese insurers shift into domestic bonds
candidates.claim: Rising domestic yields are prompting life insurers to repatriate allocations from foreign debt back into Japanese government bonds.

evidence.title: Global Market: Japan life insurers eye domestic bonds as foreign debt selling grows
evidence.note: Japan life insurers eye domestic bonds as rising yields make local debt more attractive and foreign selling accelerates.
